ink.role: Dominant deep navy field, primary text on light surfaces, and closing/opening authority.
ink.rationale: This is the brand-locked navy and the main weight of Direction A; it prevents the site from drifting into generic light finance templates.

action.role: Restrained gold coordination route, fine rules, CTA fill, focus state, and small emphasis.
action.rationale: Gold is a thin signal for decisions and actions, never a broad luxury fill or casino palette.

mist.role: Clinical bridge field used once for the white-coat pathway index and occasional quiet sub-band tint.
mist.rationale: Mist blue brings medical context into the system without creating a purple-blue SaaS gradient.

surface.role: Warm ivory editorial paper for explanatory diagrams, process, and portrait essay.
surface.rationale: Ivory gives the site a consultative paper quality and creates relief between the navy fields.

white.role: Quiet ledger surface, proof canvas, and high-contrast type on navy fields.
white.rationale: White is reserved for clarity and ledger breathing room rather than becoming the whole homepage.

charcoal.role: Body copy and secondary explanatory text on light surfaces.
charcoal.rationale: Charcoal softens long-form reading while preserving contrast and avoiding pure-black harshness.

relationships.intent: Primary headlines and body copy remain legible on the dominant navy.
Editorial display and role labels retain high authority on warm paper.
CTA labels remain readable when gold is used as a measured action surface.
The continuous coordination line is visible without becoming a broad decorative fill.
Longer summary copy reads clearly in quiet ledger entries.
Audience labels stay crisp over the clinical bridge color.

image_evidence.influence: Establishes the navy-dominant opening field and demonstrates that gold functions as a route and CTA signal.
Proves the quiet ledger can rely on white and charcoal without becoming generic finance stock.
Shows mist blue used as a single clinical bridge rather than as a repeated SaaS palette.

context_checks: Reserved logo and brand field are tested against navy and ivory without redesigning the mark.
Generated imagery is shown beside the exact mist and navy tokens to prove palette discipline.
Gold appears as action and route signal only, not a broad decorative luxury fill.
White, ivory, and charcoal are tested as quiet ledger and long-copy relationships.
CTA and focus relationships preserve high contrast.

brand_constraints: Navy #0B1F3A is brand-locked and dominates opening and closing fields.
Gold #C8A65A is restrained and structural; do not oversaturate or use black-and-gold casino styling.
Mist #DCE8F2 appears once as the clinical bridge and should not become the dominant palette.
Use ivory #F6F2E8, white, and charcoal #38373E only in role-based contexts.
Avoid purple-blue SaaS gradients, invented accent hues, coins, handshakes, market-chart decoration, and badge-like gold seals.
art_director_rationale: The palette works as a guided consultation: navy creates authority, ivory and white create editorial legibility, mist blue provides one clinical bridge, charcoal supports longer reading, and gold is limited to decisions, action, and route continuity.
builder_freedom: The builder may add opacity layers or image overlays using approved tokens if contrast and edge-color contracts are preserved.
The builder may vary surface proportions by responsive viewport while keeping the overall distribution intent.
The builder may use gold for focus rings, hairlines, and CTA states, but must avoid broad gold backgrounds except intentional CTA fills.
